original_prompt: Find growing B2B software companies in Southeast Asia. Prioritise companies with innovative products, strong leadership teams, and evidence of international expansion.

spec.objective: Identify growing B2B software companies in Southeast Asia that have innovative products, strong leadership teams, and evidence of international expansion.
spec.target_description: Growing B2B software companies in Southeast Asia with innovative products, strong leadership teams, and evidence of international expansion.

criteria.description: Company operates in the B2B software sector.
evidence_hints: Company description mentions B2B, SaaS, enterprise software, or business software
Product offerings target other businesses rather than consumers

criteria.description: Company is headquartered in or has primary operations in Southeast Asia.
evidence_hints: Company location in Southeast Asian countries (e.g., Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, etc.)
Regional focus mentioned in about page or press releases

criteria.description: Company shows signs of growth (revenue, headcount, funding, or market traction).
Company offers innovative or differentiated products.
Company has a strong leadership team with relevant experience.
evidence_hints: Founders/Executives with prior successful exits or domain expertise
Board members or advisors with strong backgrounds

criteria.description: Company demonstrates evidence of international expansion beyond Southeast Asia.
evidence_hints: Offices or customers in other regions (e.g., North America, Europe, ANZ)

queries.rationale: Broad discovery of B2B software companies in the target region.

queries.query: fast-growing SaaS startups Southeast Asia Series A Series B
queries.rationale: Targets companies with funding signals that indicate growth stage.

queries.query: innovative B2B technology companies Southeast Asia international expansion
queries.rationale: Combines innovation and international expansion signals in one query.

queries.query: Southeast Asian software companies expanding globally
queries.rationale: Focuses on the international expansion preference directly.

queries.query: leadership team Southeast Asian B2B software scale-up
queries.rationale: Surfaces content about leadership teams at growing B2B software firms in the region.
